@Polynomial.taylor_X : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) Polynomial.X = Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r

theorem Polynomial.taylor_X.{u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) Polynomial.X = Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r :=
fun {R} [Semiring R] r ↦ Polynomial.X_comp

@MvPolynomial.eval₂_X : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {S₁ : Type u_2} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁) (g : σ → S₁) (n : σ), MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g (MvPolynomial.X n) = g n

theorem MvPolynomial.eval₂_X.{u, v, u_1} : ∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁) (g : σ → S₁) (n : σ), MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g (MvPolynomial.X n) = g n :=
fun {R} {S₁} {σ} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] f g n ↦
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans (MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial f g)
            (Eq.trans
              (congr (congrArg HMul.hMul (RingHom.map_one f))
                (Eq.trans
                  (Finsupp.prod_single_index
                    (of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (pow_zero (g n))) 1) (eq_self 1))))
                  (pow_one (g n))))
              (one_mul (g n)))))
        (g n))
      (eq_self (g n)))
